newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill Pakistani Shiite activist.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Pakistani Shiite activist.

text.p: Masked gunmen shot dead a Shiite Moslem activist in Pakistans central province of Punjab on Sunday, police said.
They said the two attackers fired Kalashnikov assault rifles at Dr Riaz Hussain Bozdar at his clinic in Jalalpur Pirwala, 95 km (60 miles) north of the city of Multan.
Bozdar, the local sub-district president of the Shiite Tehrik-i-Jafaria party, was killed instantly and the gunmen fled on a motorcycle.
Rival militant groups from the majority Sunni Moslem sect and the minority Shiites blame each other for a series of attacks in Punjab province.
